stations.title: Paper count
stations.text: 400 invitation sheets in the store room.
stations.note: The next step has to wait for it.

captions: At the counter, Sefton needs the paper count, then the press queue, then an answer.
Today then() gives back nothing, so the chain breaks after its first step.
You make then() give back a docket each step can wait on, in three tasks.
Now the question runs step by step and ends on the first free day.
Sefton writes the steps one under the other, and the answer comes out at the end.
